climate.periodLabel: The requested parameters are retrieved from a pre-computed climatological period (January 2001 - December 2025)
climate.periodValidated: values equal the project's 2001–2020 point files, 1092/1092, 2026-10-10
climate.rule: Each box takes the POWER cells that hold its centre, which is the rule of the POWER point API used for the hand-picked sites. MERRA-2 (T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, T2M_RANGE, RH2M, PRECTOTCORR, WS2M, PS, TS, TS_MAX, TS_MIN; 0.5 x 0.625 deg): lat_c = round(lat / 0.5) * 0.5, lon_c = -180 + round((lon + 180) / 0.625) * 0.625. CERES SYN1deg (ALLSKY_SRF_ALB, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, ALLSKY_SFC_UV_INDEX; 1 x 1 deg): lat_c = floor(lat) + 0.5, lon_c = floor(lon) + 0.5. Nothing is averaged across cells. 'straddles' lists the grids with a cell edge inside the box. A cell's elev_m is the elevation POWER reports with it; for a SYN1deg cell that is the nearest MERRA-2 cell's elevation, not a 1 deg mean, so the cell-gap check uses the MERRA-2 cell. inJordan = share of the cell inside the Natural Earth polygon, from about 0.01 x 0.01 deg samples.

flagRules.straddlesCellEdge: a MERRA-2 or SYN1deg cell edge runs through the box ('straddles' is not empty)
flagRules.climateCellMostlyOutside: the box's MERRA-2 cell (4 of the 5 climate factors) has less than 50 % of its area in Jordan (inJordan < 0.5). 'cellsMostlyOutside' also lists the 1 deg SYN1deg albedo cell when it is under 50 %; that alone does not set the flag, because most 1 deg cells along the border are mostly outside Jordan

gridPositions.rule: every cell centre lies exactly on the MERRA-2 or SYN1deg grid, and every file of a grid holds the same cells

elevations.rule: a cell's elevation is identical in every parameter file of its grid

solarOverlap.rule: merra/<solar>.json (narrow box) equals syn1deg/<solar>.json (wide box) cell by cell

controls.rule: the regional cells of the 5 Jordan sites and Amman equal the project's point files data/raw/power/<id>.json value for value (14 parameters x 12 months + annual) and in grid elevation; the 5 sites also equal data/sites.json power.annual and gridElevation_m

fillValues.rule: no annual value of a used cell is the fill value -999 or missing

edgeTies.rule: no box centre lies exactly on a cell edge (where the rule would be a tie)

allBoxes.rule: every box of stages/grid.json has one record
